name: mas-cursor-framework
description: Autonomous multi-agent product engineering system for Cursor and modern AI IDEs. Orchestrates 35+ specialized skills across 6 tiers (PM, Architecture, On-Device SLM & Cloud GenAI, Android, Backend, DevOps, QA) with zero-token routing, filesystem artifact handoffs, and 15+ automated audit gates. Powered by /mas and token-efficient /mas-lite.

alternative_descriptions.developer_centric: Autonomous full-lifecycle software engineering team for Cursor. Coordinates 35+ specialized skills across 6 tiers—Product Management, Architecture, GenAI/SLM, Android, Backend, and DevOps—via deterministic zero-token routing, structured filesystem handoffs, and 15+ quality audit gates. Execute with /mas or low-cost tiered pipelines via /mas-lite.
alternative_descriptions.enterprise_governance: Enterprise-grade multi-agent framework for Cursor & AI IDEs. Transforms coding assistants into an autonomous 6-tier engineering team: PM, Architecture, GenAI (MediaPipe Gemma & LiteLLM), Android, Backend, and DevOps. Features zero-token coordinator routing, artifact filesystem buses, and 15+ automated quality, security, and eval audit gates.
alternative_descriptions.action_oriented: Autonomous 6-tier software engineering organization for Cursor. Orchestrates 35+ specialist agents (PM, Architecture, GenAI & on-device SLM, Android, Backend, DevOps, QA) with zero-token routing, artifact filesystem handoffs, and strict reviewer quality gates. Slash commands: /mas for full product delivery and /mas-lite for token-efficient tiers.
